name: Vanta
titleTag: Vanta alternative for file evidence | docstoc
metaDescription: Vanta automates compliance programmes. docstoc certifies single files with a hash and a verify link. How they differ and when each one fits.
headline: Vanta runs the programme, docstoc certifies the file
sub: Different jobs: Vanta automates compliance work across your tools, docstoc fixes a single document in time with a public verify link.
whatItIs: Vanta is a compliance and risk platform. Its site lists compliance automation, continuous GRC, risk management, third party risk, questionnaire automation and a Trust Center. It names SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA and HITRUST among its frameworks, claims 35+ frameworks in total, and says it pulls data from 400+ tools. Vanta describes its customers as startups, mid-market and enterprise.
whereTheyAreStronger: Automated evidence collection: Vanta says it pulls data from 400+ tools, which docstoc does not do.
Framework coverage: the site cites 35+ frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and GDPR.
Wider scope: risk management, third party risk, questionnaire automation and a Trust Center sit in the same product.
A named customer base from startup to enterprise, which suits teams heading into a formal audit.
whereDocstocFits: You have a file that must stay unchanged, such as a contract, an invoice or an exported report, and want a fingerprint that anyone can re-check.
Hashing happens in the browser with SHA-256, so the file itself need not be uploaded to create the certificate.
Counterparties get a public verify link without needing an account or a Vanta login.
The same workspace drafts invoice chase emails, which you review and send yourself.

comparison.competitor: Compliance and risk automation across frameworks and connected tools.
comparison.docstoc: Certifies single files and drafts invoice chase emails.

comparison.competitor: Lists SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, HITRUST and more, 35+ in total.
comparison.docstoc: None. docstoc does not map controls or prepare audits.

comparison.competitor: Pulls data from connected tools automatically.
comparison.docstoc: You supply the file. docstoc records its hash and time.

comparison.competitor: Trust Center for showing security posture.
comparison.docstoc: Public verify page per file, optional Bitcoin timestamp.

comparison.competitor: No prices on the pages we opened; plans are linked from the site.
comparison.docstoc: Certificates are free to create and check. Business is $39.99 per month at the time of writing.

whenToChoose.competitor: Choose Vanta if you need to prepare for a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit and want evidence gathered continuously from your cloud, identity and ticketing tools, with risk and vendor management in the same place.
whenToChoose.docstoc: Choose docstoc if you only need to prove that a particular file existed in a given form on a given day, or you want a light tool beside your GRC platform for invoices, contracts and chase evidence. It is not compliance advice.

faq.q: Does docstoc replace Vanta?
faq.a: No. docstoc does not replace Vanta. It certifies individual files with a SHA-256 fingerprint and a public verification page, and it does not map controls or run compliance checks.

faq.q: Can I use docstoc for SOC 2 evidence?
faq.a: Only as a supporting record. docstoc can certify an exported report or screenshot pack so its content is fixed in time, but your auditor decides what counts as evidence, and docstoc does not promise any audit outcome.

faq.q: Does docstoc connect to Vanta?
faq.a: No. There is no Vanta integration. Export the file you want to prove, certify it in docstoc and store the verify link with your audit packet.

name: Microsoft Purview
titleTag: Microsoft Purview alternative for file proof | docstoc
metaDescription: Purview governs and secures data inside the Microsoft estate. docstoc only certifies a single file. Where they differ and when to use each.
headline: Purview governs your Microsoft data, docstoc certifies one file
sub: Purview manages data security, retention and audit logs: docstoc gives a single document a fingerprint and a public check.
whatItIs: Microsoft Purview is Microsoft's product family for securing and governing data across on-premises, multicloud and SaaS environments. Its compliance side includes Audit, Communication Compliance, Compliance Manager, Data Lifecycle Management, eDiscovery and Records Management. Compliance Manager offers prebuilt assessments for more than 360 industry and regional standards, according to Microsoft Learn. Pricing is through the Purview Suite or pay as you go.
whereTheyAreStronger: A unified audit log capturing user and admin operations across Microsoft 365 services, with long-term retention.
Retention and deletion policies across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
Records Management, which can declare items as immutable records and give proof of deletion.
eDiscovery for legal cases, and Compliance Manager with prebuilt assessments for 360+ standards.
whereDocstocFits: The file sits outside Microsoft 365, or you want proof that works without any tenant.
A person with no Microsoft licence can still open the verify page.
The fingerprint is created in the browser, so setup takes seconds and no admin rights.
You also want drafted chase emails for unpaid invoices, which docstoc does not send for you.

comparison.competitor: Data security, governance and compliance across a data estate.
comparison.docstoc: Certifies single files; drafts invoice chase emails.

comparison.competitor: Records Management can declare items as immutable regulatory records.
comparison.docstoc: No records management. A certificate records a hash and time but does not lock the file.

comparison.competitor: Unified audit log across Microsoft 365 services.
comparison.docstoc: Public verify page per certificate; SoD approval history on chase sends (Business).

comparison.competitor: Admins inside your Microsoft tenant.
comparison.docstoc: Anyone with the link, no account.

comparison.competitor: Purview Suite or pay as you go, per Microsoft; no figures on the page we opened.
comparison.docstoc: Free certificates; Business $39.99 per month at the time of writing.

whenToChoose.competitor: Choose Purview if your documents and email live in Microsoft 365 and you need retention, audit logging, eDiscovery and compliance assessments managed by IT under one set of policies.
whenToChoose.docstoc: Choose docstoc if you need a simple, outward-facing proof that one file existed in one form, shareable with someone outside your organisation. It is not records management or legal advice.

faq.q: Does docstoc replace Microsoft Purview?
faq.a: No. docstoc does not replace Microsoft Purview. It certifies individual files with a SHA-256 fingerprint and a public verification page, and it does not map controls or run compliance checks.

faq.q: Does docstoc lock a file like a Purview record?
faq.a: No. docstoc stores a fingerprint and a timestamp. Anyone can later re-hash the file and compare, but docstoc does not prevent changes to your copy.

faq.q: Can I certify files from SharePoint in docstoc?
faq.a: Yes, download the file and hash it in the browser. There is no direct Purview or SharePoint connector.

name: AWS Security Hub
titleTag: AWS Security Hub alternative for files | docstoc
metaDescription: AWS Security Hub aggregates cloud security findings and checks. docstoc certifies single files. See the difference and where each one fits.
headline: AWS Security Hub reads your cloud, docstoc seals a file
sub: Security Hub checks your AWS accounts: docstoc has no cloud scanning and only fixes a document in time.
whatItIs: AWS Security Hub (documented as Security Hub CSPM) gives a view of your security state in AWS and checks your environment against standards. AWS lists the AWS Foundational Security Best Practices, CIS, PCI DSS and NIST among them. It collects findings from services such as GuardDuty, Inspector and Macie, plus supported partner products, in a standard format. Automation rules and EventBridge can trigger remediation.
whereTheyAreStronger: Continuous security checks against AWS best practices, CIS, PCI DSS and NIST, producing control findings.
Findings from several AWS services and partner products in one place, in one format.
Automation: rules that update findings and EventBridge actions for tickets or remediation.
Multi-account view with cross-Region aggregation and a dashboard.
whereDocstocFits: You are not looking for cloud posture checks but for a proof of a file, such as an exported findings report you send to a customer.
The certificate shows when that export was fixed, with a public verify page.
No AWS account or Config setup is needed to create or check a certificate.
Chase drafts for unpaid invoices are on the same site, with sending left to you.

comparison.competitor: Cloud security posture checks and findings aggregation.
comparison.docstoc: File certificates and invoice chase drafts.

comparison.competitor: AWS FSBP, CIS, PCI DSS, NIST, per AWS documentation.
comparison.docstoc: None.

comparison.competitor: AWS accounts, services and supported partner products.
comparison.docstoc: Individual files you choose to certify.

comparison.competitor: Needs AWS Config enabled for most control findings.
comparison.docstoc: Hash in the browser; no cloud account.

comparison.competitor: 30-day free trial, then charges for security checks and ingested findings; see AWS pricing page.
comparison.docstoc: Free certificates; Business $39.99 per month at the time of writing.

whenToChoose.competitor: Choose AWS Security Hub if you run workloads in AWS and want ongoing checks, aggregated findings and automated responses across accounts and Regions.
whenToChoose.docstoc: Choose docstoc if you need to prove a report, contract or export has not changed since a date, or want a tool outside AWS for invoice chasing. It does not assess cloud security.

faq.q: Does docstoc replace AWS Security Hub?
faq.a: No. docstoc does not replace AWS Security Hub. It certifies individual files with a SHA-256 fingerprint and a public verification page, and it does not map controls or run compliance checks.

faq.q: Can docstoc show my AWS environment is secure?
faq.a: No. docstoc does not scan cloud accounts. It can certify a report you exported from Security Hub so its content is fixed in time, but it says nothing about the state of your environment.

faq.q: Does docstoc import Security Hub findings?
faq.a: No. There is no connector. Export what you need, then certify the file.
